model.title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 East Grant Avenue in Georgetown, Ohio, as the "Ulysses S. Grant Post Office Building".
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Jon Husted (R-OH)

summary.text: The bill would rename a postal facility in Georgetown, Ohio, after former President Ulysses S. Grant, honoring his historical connection to the area.
